## Featured work

::: {.project-grid}
::: {.project-card}
### CGRP Drug Discovery Machine Learning

A machine-learning workflow for predicting the potency of CGRP receptor antagonists from molecular structure. The project covers chemical data preparation, molecular fingerprints, feature selection, model tuning, evaluation, and deployment through a Streamlit application.

**Python · scikit-learn · ChEMBL · Molecular Fingerprints · Streamlit**

**Test performance:** R² 0.815 · RMSE 0.445 pIC50

[Explore project →](https://github.com/danigeiger/CGRP_project){.project-link}
[Launch app →](https://cgrp-ic50-predictor.streamlit.app){.project-link}
:::

::: {.project-card}
### Retail Analytics & Business Intelligence

An end-to-end analytics project built from a retail sales dataset, moving from data validation and feature engineering to SQL business analysis, dimensional modeling, and Power BI reporting.

**Python · Pandas · DuckDB · SQL · Power BI · Regression**

**Dataset scale:** $2.30M sales · 5,009 orders

[Explore project →](https://github.com/danigeiger/e_commerce_duckdb_project){.project-link}
:::
:::
